title: ruminating
description: Morphism: (subject, memory) -> bounded re-derivation. Repeatedly dreams over one subject. Per the rumination/self-reflection note, unbounded introspection is pathological rumination; bounded introspection that halts when it stops producing is self-reflection. So it is bounded (maxRounds) and halts on no-new-derivation -- the governance bound is the line between the two. INTERNAL, no network. HACKING: verb name admitted.
